Name: AmoGUS (AmonGUS but I added overworld sprites)
Author: LeBluBird
Description:
This mod was HEAVILY inspired by AmonGUS (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12222), and changes Gus into an Among Us crewmate, including overworld sprites and portraits.
AmonGUS only had the portraits, so I decided to expand upon it by making overworld sprites as well as portraits in my own style.

Downloads.Description: Altered the order of the left-facing sprites, fixing an issue where Gus would stand in one of his walking frames.
